defective.instructions: Is this carpet defective? The image shows a close-up of carpet fabric.

criteria.true: yes, the carpet has a visible defect: a colour stain on the carpet, a cut in the carpet fabric, a hole in the carpet, a metal piece on the carpet, a loose thread on the carpet
criteria.false: no, the carpet is intact and defect-free

defect_type.instructions: What kind of defect does this carpet have?

criteria.color: a colour stain on the carpet
criteria.cut: a cut in the carpet fabric
criteria.metal_contamination: a metal piece on the carpet
criteria.thread: a loose thread on the carpet
